import html # Template for the user profile. The placeholders are marked with {name}, {bio}, and {status}. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

{status}
""" def create_user_profile(user_name: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML snippet for a user profile. Parameters ---------- user_name : str The user's full name. biography : str A multi-sentence biography provided by the user. status : str A brief, current status update from the user. Returns ------- str An HTML string containing the sanitized and formatted user profile information. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the arguments are not strings. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(user_name, str): raise ValueError("user_name must be a string") if not isinstance(biography, str): raise ValueError("biography must be a string") if not isinstance(status, str): raise ValueError("status must be a string") # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS safe_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status)
